description: This file handles AJAX requests related to wireless network configuration and management, including updating WiFi settings, WPS setup, MAC filtering, and band steering configurations in a network device.

methods.name: validChecksum
methods.description: Validates the checksum of a WPS pin based on its digits.

methods.name: validFilterParam
methods.description: Validates filtering parameters ensuring characters and MAC addresses are printable and valid.

methods.name: MiniApplySSID
methods.description: Applies settings to a specific SSID, used when changing SSID configurations.
